statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0414 is exponential event growth in pulldown-cmark 0.13.0 through 0.13.4, and only applies to programs that parse Markdown with Options::ENABLE_WIKILINKS. pulldown-cmark appears in the SBOM because the Cargo.lock of flux v0.201.0, the Flux query engine that Kapacitor links as libflux, lists it, but it is not compiled into Kapacitor. flux-core declares it as an optional dependency that only flux-core's `doc` feature enables, and flux-core is its only dependent in the lock file. Kapacitor builds libflux with `cargo build --release --no-default-features --features=cffi`, and flux v0.201.0 depends on flux-core with default-features = false, so `doc` is off. The amd64 kapacitord binary contains no symbols from the pulldown_cmark crate, while the crates that are compiled in (anyhow, chrono, libflate, parking_lot_core) do.
